snippet.title: Stellatum - Launch Trailer | PS5
snippet.description:
Stellatum is a new exciting scroll shooter. Equip your battleship's guns, install faster engines, and increase the power of your reactor. Throw a barrage of rockets on hordes of enemy ships, burning everything in your path!
